notes: Provider credentials never enter the worker environment; the TVC broker owns Kimi credential resolution.
Master Records authentication/receipt secrets never enter the worker environment; the Master Records local custody broker owns them.
The v2 worker binds Universal InTr and Governance to the exact TVC/Moonshot provider JSON bytes and preserves the admitted envelope through TVC execution.
Universal InTr TRANSPORT_COMPLETE and StegCore Governance ALLOW are separate mandatory evidence classes.
No hosted runtime, source fetch, second machine, new scheduler, or alternate authority path is admitted.
